method: Each answer was derived exclusively with the ordinal-date (day-of-year) formula method. For each date with calendar year Y: (1) ordinal = day-of-year, with leap status of Y determined by the Gregorian rule (divisible by 4 and not by 100, unless divisible by 400); (2) ISO weekday 1..7 (1=Monday) computed arithmetically via Zeller's congruence h = (q + floor(13(m+1)/5) + K + floor(K/4) + floor(J/4) + 5J) mod 7 (Jan/Feb treated as months 13/14 of Y-1; h: 0=Sat..6=Fri), converted to ISO weekday by ((h+5) mod 7) + 1; (3) raw week = floor((ordinal - weekday + 10)/7); (4) boundary rules applied literally: raw week 0 -> ISO year Y-1 with week number weeks(Y-1); raw week 53 when Y lacks 53 weeks -> ISO year Y+1, week 01; otherwise ISO year Y, week = raw week. weeks(y)=53 iff Jan 1 of y (its weekday computed by the same Zeller arithmetic) is a Thursday, or y is leap and Jan 1 is a Wednesday; else 52. No nearest-Thursday or Thursday-of-week reasoning was used at any step. Per-date intermediates: [2021-01-01] 2021 not leap, ordinal=1, Zeller h=167 mod 7=6 (Friday) -> weekday=5, raw week=floor((1-5+10)/7)=0 -> week-0 rule: ISO year 2020; Jan 1 2020 h=165 mod 7=4 (Wednesday) and 2020 is leap so weeks(2020)=53 -> 2020-W53-5. [2016-01-03] 2016 leap, ordinal=3, h=162 mod 7=1 (Sunday) -> weekday=7, raw week=floor((3-7+10)/7)=0 -> week-0 rule: ISO year 2015; Jan 1 2015 h=159 mod 7=5 (Thursday) so weeks(2015)=53 -> 2015-W53-7. [2015-12-28] 2015 not leap, ordinal=362, h=184 mod 7=2 (Monday) -> weekday=1, raw week=floor((362-1+10)/7)=53; weeks(2015)=53 (Jan 1 2015 Thursday) so week 53 stands in year 2015 -> 2015-W53-1. [2020-12-31] 2020 leap, ordinal=366, h=194 mod 7=5 (Thursday) -> weekday=4, raw week=floor((366-4+10)/7)=53; weeks(2020)=53 (leap, Jan 1 Wednesday) so week 53 stands -> 2020-W53-4. [2019-12-30] 2019 not leap, ordinal=364, h=191 mod 7=2 (Monday) -> weekday=1, raw week=floor((364-1+10)/7)=53; Jan 1 2019 h=164 mod 7=3 (Tuesday), 2019 not leap so weeks(2019)=52 -> week-53 rule: ISO year 2020, week 01 -> 2020-W01-1. [2022-01-02] 2022 not leap, ordinal=2, h=169 mod 7=1 (Sunday) -> weekday=7, raw week=floor((2-7+10)/7)=0 -> week-0 rule: ISO year 2021; Jan 1 2021 is Friday (h=167 mod 7=6), 2021 not leap so weeks(2021)=52 -> 2021-W52-7. [2024-12-30] 2024 leap, ordinal=365, h=198 mod 7=2 (Monday) -> weekday=1, raw week=floor((365-1+10)/7)=53; Jan 1 2024 h=170 mod 7=2 (Monday), so despite 2024 being leap weeks(2024)=52 -> week-53 rule: ISO year 2025, week 01 -> 2025-W01-1. [2025-01-05] 2025 not leap, ordinal=5, h=176 mod 7=1 (Sunday) -> weekday=7, raw week=floor((5-7+10)/7)=1, no boundary rule -> 2025-W01-7. [2017-01-01] 2017 not leap, ordinal=1, h=162 mod 7=1 (Sunday) -> weekday=7, raw week=floor((1-7+10)/7)=0 -> week-0 rule: ISO year 2016; Jan 1 2016 h=160 mod 7=6 (Friday), 2016 leap but Jan 1 not Wednesday so weeks(2016)=52 -> 2016-W52-7. [2018-12-31] 2018 not leap, ordinal=365, h=191 mod 7=2 (Monday) -> weekday=1, raw week=floor((365-1+10)/7)=53; Jan 1 2018 h=163 mod 7=2 (Monday), not leap so weeks(2018)=52 -> week-53 rule: ISO year 2019, week 01 -> 2019-W01-1.
